name: The Study
notes: This is 'The Study Lounge', a cocktail/dive bar at 1678 Greenfield Dr, El Cajon (address matches, checked via Chrome). Yelp categorizes it purely as 'Cocktail Bars', its 23-photo gallery has only 'Inside' and 'Outside' categories (no Menu photos, no dated menu photo to cite), and the owner's own Yelp bio describes only bartenders, liquor selection and beer kegs -- no food. BeerMenus lists the venue with zero beers/prices posted. A WebSearch summary mentioning burgers/loaded fries/wings traced back to the-study-lounge.hey-restaurants.com, an AI-generated directory-farm page with generic filler prose and no actual menu content -- not a real source. Restaurantguru shows only a generic 'price per person' range ($10-20), no per-item prices. Treating this as a drink-only bar with no priced food menu published anywhere reachable.

name: Break Point
notes: Break Point is a nightclub/bar/bowling venue at 945 Garnet Ave, Pacific Beach (address on the menu images matches exactly). Its Food Menu page embeds the full priced food menu as two images (Starters+Tacos; Mains+Salads+Flatbreads), read directly. Captured all 5 food sections shown: Starters, Tacos, Mains, Salads, Flatbreads. Did not capture the separate Drink Menu or Catering Menu (adjuncts, not part of the core food menu). 'Add Protein' salad add-ons ($5/$6/$7) are modifiers, not separate dishes, so excluded.

name: Feng Cha
notes: Boba/milk tea shop's own first-party ordering platform (Paytronix, linked directly from fengchausa.com/store/san-diego/). Page is a client-rendered Nuxt SPA (no server-rendered price payload reachable via curl), so read via browser. Address on the ordering page: '4340 Genesee ave, San diego, CA 92117' -- matches batch address. Captured all 10 base sections (What's New, UBE Series, Dirty Series, Milk Tea, Blended Series, Fruit Drinks, Matcha Series, Coffee Drinks, Au Lait Series, Milk Foam Tea & Original Tea, Milk Foam Cake). The site also lists '(HOT)' duplicate sections that are the hot-served version of drinks already captured iced/cold at the same or matching prices ((HOT) What's New, (HOT) Milk Tea, (HOT) Milk Foam Tea & Original Tea) -- skipped as duplicates rather than double-counting. 3 items were out of stock with no price shown (Passionfruit Milk Tea, Purple Reign, Passionfruit Green Tea) and were dropped per house rules. Prices are not uniform/round (6.99, 7.25, 6.35, 5.85, 5.00, etc.), no evidence of a markup pattern.

name: The Bancroft Bar
notes: Own site (address 9143 Campo Rd, Spring Valley, CA 91977 matches) brands itself 'Live Music & Cold Drinks in Spring Valley' -- a 21+ music venue with a show calendar and a 'Stuff 4 Sale' merch page, no menu link or food content anywhere on the site. WebSearch corroborates: a dive/music bar with craft beer, cocktails, darts, karaoke and pool, and food described as unclear/not much served on-site. No per-item food or drink prices found on any source. Treating as a drink-only venue with no priced menu, per house guidance on drink-only dive bars.

Captured all 4 board sections: Entrees, Kids Meals, Sides, Healthy Options, Desserts. Beverages (fountain drinks, bottled water, beer, cocktails) were listed on the official page with no prices anywhere and were not on the photographed board, so excluded.
